verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the SALE letters have lost their circles and read 'E S A L' out of order, stacked at the left edge; 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' is tiny and set apart from them; the lower half of the canvas is empty except for a stray tassel fragment; and the decorations are crammed into the upper middle. B is still broken: the SALE circles sit hard against the right edge; the S, A and L are tiny and fall to the bottom of their circles instead of centring (only E is centred); the headline is small and tucked into the top-left; and the duplicated lantern clusters overpower the message. B still keeps the letter order and the circle-and-tassel motif, so it is the less bad of the two.
